## `GET /targets`

Saved targets by name, each with its credential status (never a value).

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                             |
| ------ | ------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | array of [TargetResource](/reference/api/models/#targetresource) |

## `POST /targets`

Save a target block under a name. Keys are set separately (credentials).

**Request body:** [TargetCreate](/reference/api/models/#targetcreate) (`application/json`)

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                    |
| ------ | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `201`  | Successful Response | [TargetResource](/reference/api/models/#targetresource) |

## `POST /targets/check`

Check an unsaved target block, as New run's YAML has it; its secretRefs resolve as a run's would.

**Request body:** [UnsavedTargetCheck](/reference/api/models/#unsavedtargetcheck) (`application/json`)

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                      |
| ------ | ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `200`  | Successful Response | [TargetCheckView](/reference/api/models/#targetcheckview) |

## `DELETE /targets/{target_id}`

Delete the target and the Secrets servtuner manages for it. Past runs keep their copy.

| Parameter   | In   | Type     | Required | Description |
| ----------- | ---- | -------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `target_id` | path | `string` | Yes      |             |

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                              |
| ------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `204`  | Successful Response | None                                                              |
| `422`  | Validation Error    | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/models/#httpvalidationerror) |

## `GET /targets/{target_id}`

## `POST /targets/{target_id}/check`

## `PUT /targets/{target_id}/credentials/{slot}`

Set or replace a key. Write-only: the response has no body, and no route ever returns the value.

| Parameter   | In   | Type     | Required | Description |
| ----------- | ---- | -------- | -------- | ----------- |
| `target_id` | path | `string` | Yes      |             |
| `slot`      | path | `string` | Yes      |             |

**Request body:** [CredentialInput](/reference/api/models/#credentialinput) (`application/json`)

| Status | Meaning             | Body                                                              |
| ------ | ------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `204`  | Successful Response | None                                                              |
| `422`  | Validation Error    | [HTTPValidationError](/reference/api/models/#httpvalidationerror) |
